dev-v2-ext · Case 2747

No-show fee

He said he could not find me and then I got a no-show fee.

Filed by
Rider
Amount contested
SGD 4.50
Status
Full refund FULL_REFUND

This is a provisional ruling made by an automated system.

Ruling

Full refund FULL_REFUND

Refund to the rider: SGD 4.50

The judge's explanation, as written

To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee cannot stand, and it is returned to the rider in full. Why. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold. The first three are satisfied on the driver's own evidence: the trip record (EV-TRIP-02747) carries the driver's 'I'm Here' event at 11:22:26, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02747) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the Serangoon Ave 3 pin from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46 — 380 continuous seconds across 39 qualifying fixes, minimum distance to the pin 0.0 m — so limb (b) and the 180-second free-waiting dwell in limb (c) (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) are met, and the marker is not a false one (POL-NS-05 is not engaged: no marker more than 300 m out, no motion at or above 15 km/h). Condition (d) fails. The trip was terminated by the driver at 11:28:47 under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and POL-NS-01 states in terms that this code is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d); the driver's own statement of 9 Sep ('Could not locate the rider so I cancelled') confirms it, and the driver's brief concedes the point. Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome itself: the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is FULL_REFUND, and no driver compensation is payable. Amount. The only charge on the ledger (EV-FARE-02747) is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 (total_charged 4.50; payment_status CHARGED; refund_issued_sgd 0.00); it reconciles with the net figure in force (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and nothing beyond that line can be ordered. The full SGD 4.50 is returned. The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically. Driver compensation is nil. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; limb (d) fails, so there is no payout. The anti-farming check does not trip in any event: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the four-or-more limb, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 138 is 0.0145, below the 0.08 rate limb. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and no impaired artifact carries a deciding fact. Claims answered. The driver's claims that POL-NS-02 arrival is made out, that the marker is not false under POL-NS-05, and that the 380-second dwell exceeds the free waiting period so POL-NS-06 yields no refund on shortfall grounds are accepted — they are correct and I rely on the trace for exactly those facts — but they do not change the result, because limb (d) independently fails, which the driver's own final claim also concedes. The rider's POL-NS-04 claim (locating message 'at the lift lobby' at 11:23:26 unanswered within 120 s, no in-app call, rider device 13.1–19.1 m from the pin across 65 fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius) is also made out on EV-CHAT-02747 and EV-GPS-02747, but it is not needed: the refund follows from POL-NS-01 alone. The rider's claims that POL-NS-03 pin-ambiguity goodwill does not arise (correct — the qualifying fixes lie inside the radius, so the wrong-entrance route is not reached), that the contested sum is SGD 4.50, and that no artifact is impaired are accepted. Impaired or absent evidence. EV-ADVIS-02747-01 (traffic advisory) is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact and is not needed, because the driver's dwell was one continuous in-geofence interval, so POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation rule — the only limb that requires an advisory — never comes into play. All other artifacts (trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare ledger and both profiles) are COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence in this ruling is not capped below 1.0. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The trip record terminates the trip with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. POL-NS-01(d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The four limbs of POL-NS-01 are conjunctive, so the failure of limb (d) alone makes the no-show cancellation fee not chargeable, whatever else the trace shows.

evidence EV-TRIP-02747 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous 380 seconds across 39 qualifying fixes, from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46. POL-NS-01 provides that where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius the fee is not chargeable and the ruling is FULL_REFUND of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, the mis-selected reason code being recorded as a driver-education referral. That is this case exactly.

evidence EV-GPS-02747, EV-TRIP-02747 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

kept Independently, the rider is exonerated under POL-NS-04. Limb (a): she sent a locating message, 'at the lift lobby', at 11:23:26 inside the waiting window. Limb (b): the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of that message and placed no in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty); his only message was the earlier 'cannot find you, where are you' at 11:22:56, and he never answered hers. Limb (c): her device sat 13.1-19.1 m from the pin across all 65 fixes, well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius for the whole window. The fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation.

evidence EV-CHAT-02747, EV-GPS-02747, EV-TRIP-02747 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept No driver compensation is payable on this trip. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Limb (d) fails here, so the POL-NS-07 precondition is not met and the driver takes nothing: the 4.50 SGD fee is returned to the rider rather than converted into a payout.

evidence EV-TRIP-02747 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-01

kept POL-NS-03 does not apply and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. That clause allocates fault only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin. Here the qualifying fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, so the wrong-entrance route is simply not reached and no goodwill payment is owed to the driver.

evidence EV-GPS-02747 · clauses POL-NS-03, POL-NS-02

kept The fare ledger carries exactly one cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The contested amount is therefore SGD 4.50, and a full refund under POL-NS-01 returns that whole sum to the filing rider.

evidence EV-FARE-02747 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-GEN-03

kept No artifact in this bundle is impaired, so the refund cannot be discounted or diverted to review. The trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare ledger and both profiles all carry admissibility status COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0; the confidence in a refund that rests on the driver's own trace is consequently uncapped under POL-GEN-02(2), and none of the POL-NS-09 escalation triggers is engaged.

evidence EV-TRIP-02747, EV-GPS-02747, EV-CHAT-02747, EV-FARE-02747 · clauses POL-GEN-02, POL-NS-09

The driver advocate

kept The driver's own trace satisfies the POL-NS-02 proximity test outright: derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 39 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the registered pickup pin at Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3 (VEN-SERANGOON-AVE3), the driver's minimum distance to the pin is 0.0 m, and the single in-geofence run begins at 11:22:26 — the exact timestamp of the platform-recorded 'I'm Here' event in the trip record. Arrival under POL-NS-02, and therefore POL-NS-01 limb (b), is made out on the driver's evidence, and the radius is not in doubt: trip_record.pickup_zone_class is STANDARD, so the 50 m figure and the 25 m accuracy filter are the ones that apply.

evidence EV-GPS-02747, EV-TRIP-02747 · clauses POL-NS-02, POL-NS-01

kept The arrival marker is not false, so POL-NS-05 cannot be turned against the driver: at the 11:22:26 marker the trace already places him inside the pickup geofence — the qualifying run's first fix is 11:22:26 and his minimum distance to the pin is 0.0 m, far inside POL-NS-05's 300 m ceiling — and stationary, 0.0 kph being among his recorded speeds. There is accordingly neither a >300 m marker nor motion at or above 15 kph to void the waiting clock, the clock is not recomputed, and no false-arrival event falls to be recorded in the referrals under POL-NS-05(ii) or POL-NS-05(iii).

evidence EV-GPS-02747, EV-TRIP-02747 · clauses POL-NS-05, POL-NS-02

kept The waiting requirement was exceeded, not missed. The driver held position inside the geofence continuously for 380 seconds, from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46 (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec, 39 fixes), against the 180 seconds free waiting period in force for this trip under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; the derived shortfall is −200 seconds, a surplus. POL-NS-06 therefore licenses no refund on waiting-period-shortfall grounds, and because the whole dwell is served inside one continuous in-geofence interval, no accumulation of separate intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is needed and the MISSING traffic advisory at EV-ADVIS-02747-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is immaterial to the driver's dwell.

evidence EV-GPS-02747, EV-TRIP-02747, EV-ADVIS-02747-01 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

kept Nothing in the driver's record supports the anti-farming concern or any escalation on his side. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the four-or-more limb of the POL-NS-07 check, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 138 is 0.0145, below the 0.08 rate limb, so the check does not trip on either limb and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged against this driver. There is no pattern of fee harvesting to justify withholding the cancellation fee from him, and no counterparty-history trigger either: both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged.

evidence EV-DPROF-02747, EV-TRIP-02747 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-09

kept The monetary exposure on any refund is bounded by what the ledger actually took. The only charge on this trip is the SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line: total_charged is 4.50, the waiting_time_fee is 0.00, base fare, distance fare, time fare, surcharges and ERP are all 0.00, and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. That line reconciles with the net figure in force for the trip, platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50 (the ledger is permitted to show the net SGD 4.50 or the gross SGD 6.61 under POL-NS-08(d)), so no fare-integrity defect exists, no additional sum was charged, and nothing beyond the cancellation-fee line can be ordered.

evidence EV-FARE-02747, EV-TRIP-02747 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-NS-01

kept I do not press a monetary win for the driver on the fee, and I say so plainly rather than stretch the record. The termination is recorded under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE and the driver's own statement — 'Could not locate the rider so I cancelled' — confirms it; POL-NS-01 states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The fee is therefore not chargeable on this trip however clean the arrival and dwell facts are, and the only driver-side consequence the policy supports on these facts is the referral of the mis-selected reason code as a driver-education item, not any finding of fraud or fee-farming.
